title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
abstract: arXiv:2611.17933v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. translated_title: OutfitterBench：评估大语言模型智能体在长周期资源分配与承诺协调上的能力
translated_abstract: 在许多长周期环境中，智能体自身的选择会带来未来的约束：对有限容量的承诺会建立未来的义务，并使后续的机会失去可能。因此，要持续保持良好性能，既需要让不断演进的计划保持可行，又需要在机会变化时将资源分配的价值与其所取代的备选方案进行比较。近期的基准测试越来越多地评估大语言模型智能体在持续运营中的表现，但对于智能体如何在机会变化时重新评估资源分配、同时保持自身承诺的可行性，关注较少。我们提出了OutfitterBench，在该基准中，智能体需要管理一个户外装备租赁业务200天，从包含46种产品的目录中采购，并处理约1,100个预订请求。在固定的资金上限下，预订和不确定的上门客流需求共同竞争可用性随时间变化的可重复使用装备。对七个前沿大语言模型的实验表明，若干智能体的表现不佳（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出OutfitterBench基准，让大语言模型智能体在200天内管理一个户外装备租赁业务，以评估其在自身承诺形成未来约束的长周期场景中进行资源分配与承诺协调的能力，实验显示多数前沿模型难以在保持计划可行性的同时重新评估资源分配。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OutfitterBench, a benchmark where LLM agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business over 200 days to evaluate long-horizon resource allocation and commitment coordination, showing that frontier models struggle to keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing allocations as opportunities change.
